comments.author: yuri
comments.text:
Completed: cli plumbing layer per docs/03-cli.md §bin.

Files: cli/src/{bin,commands,config,envelope,output,hub_socket,files}.ts + tests (bin/config/envelope/hub_socket .test.ts), cli/package.json (+commander 14), tsconfig.json (typecheck cli/web), bun.lock.

Decisions:
- commander exitOverride + configureOutput: help/version exit 0 without socket; usage failures emit one hub line (stderr) or one envelope, never commander's own text.
- config resolution strict order: --config file > env (OMP_HUB_SOCK/OMP_HUB_MODEL/OMP_BIN/NO_COLOR) > ~/.hub/config.json (absent OK) > defaults; all fields validated, ConfigError = usage exit 1.
- envelope.ts exhaustive ErrorCode→exit map (1 usage/not_found/ambiguous/busy, 2 unavailable/protocol, 3 timeout); error envelopes go stdout.
- hub_socket one-shot client: hello handshake, cmdId correlation, deadline→timeout, wire codes mapped to lib HubError (busy → denied/exit 1 class).
- bodies with later-task wire/format logic throw NotImplemented (usage class) — tree/config/envelope/exit layers exercised end to end via real subprocess.

Evidence: 65 cli tests pass (config matrix, exit-code table vs real hub binary, 9 hubCmd contract tests vs in-process fake hub); workspace 157 pass, 0 fail; bunx tsc --noEmit clean. Committed b4fa03e on matchday/tk-dfr.

Note: committed unsigned (--no-gpg-sign) — 1Password op-ssh-sign helper failing repo-wide ('failed to fill whole buffer'); probed in scratch repo, same failure. Signing needs attention outside this task.

Also: git rm'd cli/src/commands/.gitkeep (dir now populated); render/ + screens/ .gitkeep left for later tasks. Left task OPEN for validator.

Real binary smokes: --help 0, -V 0, badcmd --json 1 + usage envelope, watch --json --ndjson 1, log s-x 1 never 2, --config missing 1.
